defs.def: the way things are done or organized 安排方式；布置
an agreement that you make with sb that you can both accept 商定；约定
a group of things that are organized or placed in a particular order or position; the act of placing things in a particular order 整理好的东西；整理；排列；布置

ex.s: A group of sea-dwelling people in Southeast Asia have evolved into better divers.
ex.t: 东南亚一群海上居民已经进化成了更好的潜水员。
